Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, g As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D4").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array(1, 3, -2, 4), Array(-1, 2, -3, 4), Array(5, 4, 3, 2), Array(2, 2, 2, 2))))
    ws.Range("A6:D6").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array(45000, 45001, 45005, 45010))))
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 1
        g.ModifyDateRange "A6:D6"
        Tried = g.DateRange & " " & g.Axes.Horizontal.IsDateAxis
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\dated.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        g.ModifyDateRange "Sheet1!A6:D6"
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 3
        g.ModifyDateRange "$A$6:$D$6"
        Tried = g.DateRange
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\absolute.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        g.ModifyDateRange "a6:c6"
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 5
        g.ModifyDateRange "A6"
        Tried = g.DateRange
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\cell.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        g.ModifyDateRange "nonsense"
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 7
        g.ModifyDateRange ""
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 8
        g.ModifyDateRange "Sheet9!A6:D6"
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 9
        g.ModifyDateRange "A6:D6"
        g.ModifyDateRange ""
        Tried = g.DateRange & " " & g.Axes.Horizontal.IsDateAxis
    Case 10
        g.DateRange = "A6:D6"
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 11
        g.ModifyDateRange "A6:A9"
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 12
        g.ModifyDateRange "A6:D6"
        ws.Range("A6:D6").Clear
        Tried = g.DateRange
    Case 13
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeftPlotOrder
    Case 14
        g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeftPlotOrder = True
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeftPlotOrder
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\rtl.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 15
        g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeftPlotOrder = True
        g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeftPlotOrder = False
        Tried = g.Axes.Horizontal.RightToLeftPlotOrder
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ltr.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
